# Piotr Chmielewski — AI Consultant

> Polish AI consultant based in the UK. Helping Poles abroad stop collecting knowledge and start selling it.

## About

Piotr Chmielewski is an AI consultant who works with Polish professionals living abroad (primarily UK). He helps them transform their expertise into digital products and online businesses using AI tools and strategies.

## Services

- AI consulting for solopreneurs and small businesses
- Digital product strategy
- One-on-one coaching sessions (15-min discovery calls available)
